import numpy as np
from PIL import Image
a=np.array(Image.open('/work/observations/obs_0114.png').convert('RGB')).astype(int)
R,G,B=a[:,:,0],a[:,:,1],a[:,:,2]
wh=(R>180)&(R<225)&(abs(R-G)<8)&((R-B)>5)&((R-B)<22)   # cabinet top slab
tn=(R>170)&(R<215)&((R-B)>55)&(G<R-25)                 # tan drawer front
for nm,m in (('slab',wh),('tan',tn)):
    ys,xs=np.nonzero(m); print(nm,'n',len(xs),'u',xs.min(),xs.max(),'v',ys.min(),ys.max())
print('--- per-col top of slab / top of tan')
for u in range(176,512,16):
    c=np.nonzero(wh[:,u])[0]; c=c[c>258]
    d=np.nonzero(tn[:,u])[0]
    print(u,'slabtop',int(c.min()) if len(c) else None,'slabbot',int(c.max()) if len(c) else None,
          'tantop',int(d.min()) if len(d) else None)
print('--- raw col u=192,200,208 v=350..440')
for v in range(350,445,10):
    print(v,[tuple(a[v,u]) for u in (184,192,200,208,216)])
EOF
